newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific loan raised to HK$3.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific loan raised to HK$3.8 bln.

text.p: CITIC Pacific's loan facility has been raised to HK$3.8 billion from HK$3.5 billion following an enthusiastic response in the underwriting phase, Chase Manhattan Asia said Wednesday.
Chase is coordinating arranger along with HSBC Investment Bank Asia and J.P. Morgan Securities.
The facility was oversubscribed 1.9 times to HK$6.65 billion in this phase but commitments were scaled back.
The facility is composed of two tranches.

Tranche A of HK$2.942 billion is available in Hong Kong or U.S dollars at the option of the borrower. The facility, which is structured as a 24-month revolving credit converting to a term loan, has a final maturity of seven years with a put option in year five.
Tranche B of US$110 million is available in U.S. dollars only and has a final maturity of seven years and has an availability period of six months.

Tranche A pays an interest margin of 60 basis points per annum from year one to year five and 70 basis points from year six to seven, while tranche B carries an interest margin of 67.5 basis points throughout the life of the facility.
Proceeds are to be used for general corporate requirements, including refinancing of the company's maturing debt facilities and for new investment in CITIC Pacific's core businesess.
Chase said 26 financial institutions have joined the facility as arrangers and lead managers.

They are Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, BNP Hong Kong, Banque Indosuez, Bayerische Hypotheken-und-Wechsel-Bank AG Hong Kong, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale, Hong Kong, BZW Asia, Chase Manhattan Asia, CIBC CEF, Commerz East Asia, Credit Lyonnais, Credit Suisse, DKB Hong Kong, Deutsche Bank Hong Kong, Fuji Bank, Hang Seng Bank, HSBC, Industrial Bank of Japan, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia, Long Term Credit Bank of Japan, Paribas Asia, Sakura Bank, Sanwa Bank Hong Kong, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale Hong Kong, Sumitomo Bank and Union Bank of Switzerland,
